body_text:
Casorati--Weierstrass theorem. Near an essential singularity, the
image of every punctured neighborhood is dense in $\mathbb{C}$.
Picard's great theorem strengthens this: with at most one
exceptional value, every complex value is assumed infinitely often
in every punctured neighborhood.
